query: ProcureFlow supplier invoice API portal cXML REST integration capabilities
answer: ProcureFlow-class procurement suites typically expose supplier invoice status through a REST or cXML integration, plus a supplier portal. Machine access is commonly API-first when the buyer provisions a token; portal login is the fallback.

results.title: Coupa: View and manage invoices
results.content: Supplier portals in this product family let suppliers view invoice status, rejections, and required fields. Buyers may also enable cXML or API integrations for invoice submission and status.

results.title: Coupa Supplier Portal invoice FAQ
results.content: Invoice rejection reasons, legal entity, and PO matching are common blockers. API or cXML access depends on the customer's configuration, not the platform default.
